# AquaMate Inc.

> AquaMate Inc. is a 100% Canadian-owned and operated manufacturer of premium custom vinyl pool liners, based in Collingwood, Ontario. We fabricate custom-fit liners for any pool shape or size using advanced UV protection and chemical resistant materials, manufactured in partnership with Poolside by CGT (ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2018, ISO 45001:2018 certified).

- Website: https://www.aquamatepool.com
- Phone: 1-705-445-4454
- Email: sales@aquamatepool.com
- Address: 91 Sandford Fleming Dr #5, Collingwood, ON L9Y 5A6, Canada
